purpose: Verify presence of Content-Security-Policy header to mitigate XSS and data injection attacks.
expected_secure_behavior: Server responds with robust CSP (e.g., default-src 'self'; script-src 'self').
remediation: Deploy helmet() middleware or configure Content-Security-Policy header with appropriate source directives.

purpose: Verify Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) header enforcement over HTTPS.
expected_secure_behavior: Server responds with Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Strict-Transport-Security header is missing, allowing protocol downgrade (SSL stripping).
remediation: Add Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains via helmet.hsts().

purpose: Verify anti-clickjacking protection via X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors.
expected_secure_behavior: Server sends X-Frame-Options: DENY or SAMEORIGIN, or CSP frame-ancestors 'self'.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: No framing restrictions present; site can be rendered inside arbitrary third-party <iframe>.
remediation: Set X-Frame-Options: DENY or frame-ancestors 'none' in Content-Security-Policy.

expected_vulnerable_behavior: Header is missing; browser may interpret non-executable MIME types as HTML or JavaScript.
remediation: Configure X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff header on all responses.

purpose: Check for technology fingerprinting headers (X-Powered-By, Server detailed versions).
expected_secure_behavior: X-Powered-By is suppressed and Server header exposes no version details.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Server exposes 'X-Powered-By: Express' or detailed framework version numbers.
